The `IllegalStateException: TypeToken must be created with a type argument` error occurs during minified release builds because R8 strips generic signatures and anonymous `TypeToken` subclasses by default.

The required ProGuard/R8 rules have been added to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r1/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

```pro
# Gson: Preserve generic signatures so TypeToken can resolve type arguments at runtime
-keepattributes Signature
-keepattributes *Annotation*

# Gson: Preserve TypeToken and any anonymous subclasses extending it
-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }
-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken
-keepclassmembers class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }

# Preserve model classes and fields serialized/deserialized by Gson via reflection
-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }
-keepclassmembers class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }
```

These rules instruct R8 to:
1. Preserve the `Signature` attribute required for runtime generic type reflection.
2. Keep `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and its anonymous subclasses (such as `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}` in [CatalogRepository.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/CatalogRepository.kt#L14)).
3. Preserve data model classes and fields under `vn.shelftap.lab.model` from being obfuscated or stripped when deserialized with Gson.
